summary: Native cart state and source geometry are implemented and manually verified. Host visual QA still captures an empty cart because it does not invoke qa-state for this state-less manifest route.
issues: Host page-only QA reports 84.917% because visual.js skips qa-state.prepare when cart has no manifest state, opening an anonymous empty cart and omitting cart-heading/cart-lines.
The prepared real cart is healthy and source-backed, but cannot receive a host acceptance score until that state-invocation defect is resolved.
